what: audit_task.oldloop first compared campaign-local pick indices with global probe indices and reported 6 of 395 hits on probed pairs (1.5%).
correction: picks mapped to global indices; rerun gives 394 of 395 (MAESTRO loop) and 293 of 293 (two-stage) on probed pairs.
scientific_effect: reverses a reading of the old triage utility (it is a noisy re-read of the graded cell); the uncorrected value was never used in a decision.

what: Exploratory scripts explore1-5 (session scratchpad, not frozen) ran rule variants on folds 0 and 1 before develop.py was written.
scientific_effect: development folds only; the selection reported in DEVELOPMENT.json was made by develop.py with the rules written in its header.

what: Phase D trains each development fold on the other development fold only (strict nesting); Phase E trains each estimation fold on the other four folds (the setting of the old triage).
scientific_effect: hyper-parameters (K = 10, lam = 1.0) were chosen with a ~1,000-compound training set and are not re-tuned for the ~3,300-compound training set of Phase E; this can favour or disfavour any analogue-based rule.

what: test_science.py: the first draft of the repair gate test referenced a parameter that does not exist; rewritten to test reduction to the base update (gate closed, lam = 0) and the gate's independence from the hidden side.
